brutal.description: Single crate, confirmed via official patch notes as 'the bare minimum needed for survival.' Independent of difficulty slider — usually paired with Stationeer difficulty for the full hardcore experience. Exact itemized contents are not fully published; verify your crate's tooltip in-game.
confirmed_facts: Iron Frames ARE included (confirmed via community guide)
Door kits are NOT included by default (confirmed via forum report)
Active Vent removed, replaced with Power Controller (confirmed patch note)
Autolathe and Arc Furnace still present
World-specific supplements exist: Europa Brutal includes Wind Turbine; Vulcan/Venus Brutal include Oxygen tank + 12L Water canister
